integrity: The covariance identity follows from the explicit stochastic convolution; the bath threshold and spatial-field limit use summation asymptotics and a uniform local central-binomial bound. A standalone deterministic verifier checked exact finite Lyapunov identities and sampled asymptotic predictions. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only open unidirectional chains with bath intensities D j^{-beta}, fixed D>0 and beta>=0; Gaussian field for beta<1/2 in finite-dimensional distributions, without path-space or nonlinear generalization. Homogeneous-noise finite-chain covariance is prior work.
scientific_scope: Power-law-graded independent baths in a finite directed Gaussian Ornstein–Uhlenbeck chain at the exceptional point and its size-dependent critical damping window; finite-dimensional limiting spatial fields.
title: Sharp noise-gradient regularization and a Gaussian spatial field at a nonnormal exceptional point
